notes: Native: navigator, dataGrouping (library downsampling, average per group; performance.mode "gpu" switches to boost).
Data fed as one chart-level DataTable (v13) with per-series dataMapping; formatter callbacks for Hoist formats.
Native: navigator, wheel/drag zoom, crosshair, shared tooltip.
Large data: no option needed - AG applies M4 aggregation itself. Columnar source copied to row objects (~20 ms for 250k).
Axis dates: custom UTC formatter - AG formats dates in local time only.
Navigator: native dataZoom slider + inside zoom (wheel/drag).
Large data: zero-copy typed-array dataset, sampling: 'lttb' (line series has no large/progressive mode).
